title: 布尔值与关系运算的编码 / Boolean and relational values

checks.name: v0 (numerical for values, positional for branches, short-circuit only when observable)
or as integer add: p prints 2, not a boolean
no short-circuit: inc! runs on every iteration, n = 6 instead of 3
no short-circuit: the guarded division runs with d = 0
positional everywhere: same output, 25 branches executed instead of 17, 100 instructions instead of 69
short-circuit everything: same output, 20 branches executed, 171 instructions executed

or-as-add.reason: wrong numerical encoding: or as integer add
or-as-add.explain: 数值编码下，用乘法实现 and 没问题（0/1 相乘仍是 0/1），但用加法实现 or，两边都为真时得到 2，不再是合法的布尔值。

no-short-circuit.reason: wrong: never short-circuit, evaluate both operands
no-short-circuit.explain: and/or 两边都算：k 为偶数时本来不该执行的 (inc! n) 也执行了，n 从 3 变成 6，程序不报错。

no-short-circuit-guard.reason: wrong: never short-circuit; the division guard stops guarding
no-short-circuit-guard.explain: (and (!= d 0) (> (/ x d) 4))：不短路时 d = 0 也会去做除法，生成的代码在运行时除零。

all-positional.reason: positional encoding everywhere, even when the value is stored
all-positional.explain: 值上下文也用控制流编码：每个布尔值都要经过分支再写 1 或 0，结果对，分支和指令多了。

always-short-circuit.reason: short-circuit every and/or, even pure ones
always-short-circuit.explain: 纯操作数也短路：结果对，代码里多了条件分支；有时能少执行几条指令，有时反而更多。
